title: Measurements of the mitochondrial respiration and glycolytic activity in Drosophila embryonic cells
protocol: Add 1.0 ml of XF calibrant solution to each well of a 24-well utility plate.
Cover the utility plate with the hydro-booster (pink spacer).
Place the sensor cartridge in the utility plate and cover it with the lid.
Place the sensor cartridge in a 25°C incubator for hydration over 12 hours.
Dissolve 33.8 µg of Cell-Tak in 0.1 M sodium bicarbonate (pH 8.0) to prepare 1.5 ml of solution.
Immediately add an equal volume of 1 M sodium hydroxide to adjust the pH to approximately 8.0.
Apply 50 μl of the prepared Cell-Tak solution to each well of the XF<sup>e</sup>24 cell culture microplates.
Incubate the plates at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Aspirate the Cell-Tak solution from each well.
Rinse each well twice with 200 μl of sterile water.
Put male and female flies in a fly embryo-collecting container set on a grape juice agar dish with a yeast chunk in the center.
Replace the grape juice agar dish with a new one without the yeast chunk by turning the container upside down and mildly anesthetizing the flies with CO2.
Culture the flies in a cooled incubator set at 25°C for 1 hr to collect the embryos.
Remove the grape juice agar dish with the eggs from the container, and further incubate the eggs on the dish at 25°C for 2 hrs.
Prepare Schneider's Drosophila medium containing 5% FBS and 40% bleach in water just before use, and keep both at 4°C.
Chill an autoclaved Dounce tissue homogenizer with a loose pestle on ice.
Take the eggs (embryos) on the dish out of the incubator and rinse the dish with embryo washing buffer.
Collect the embryos from the dish with a cotton swab and embryo washing buffer.
Transfer the embryo suspension into a sterilized 1.5-ml tube using a 1-ml plastic pipette.
Wash embryos in the 1.5-ml tube several times with embryo washing buffer and several times with sterilized water.
Dechorionate embryos with 1 ml of 40% bleach for 2 min.
Rinse dechorionated embryos with 1 ml of 5% FBS/Schneider's Drosophila medium four times.
Resuspend the embryos in 1 ml of 5% FBS/Schneider's Drosophila medium, and transfer into an autoclaved Dounce tissue homogenizer.
Move the Dounce pestle slowly up and down 10-12 times.
Filter the homogenized embryos through a 40-μm cell strainer into a sterilized 50-ml tube.
Transfer the filtered homogenized solution into a sterilized 1.5 ml tube.
Spin down embryonic cells at 1,000 g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully and resuspend the cell pellet using 1.0 ml of 5% FBS/Schneider's Drosophila medium.
Spin down cells again at 1,000 g for 3 min at 4°C.
Repeat step 13 two or three more times to remove debris.
Suspend the cells with 210 μl of serum-free Schneider's Drosophila medium.
Count the cell number using 10 μl of the cell suspension.
Resuspend the cells in an appropriate volume of serum-free Schneider's Drosophila medium kept at RT to achieve a desired cell density per well.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of 0.8 x 10^6 to 1.6 x 10^6 cells/ml.
Take the sensor cartridge out of the 25°C incubator.
Apply the appropriate volume of compounds to the sensor cartridge ports.
Remove the lid and hydro-booster, assemble the sensor cartridge and utility plate again.
Load the assembled sensor cartridge into the Seahorse Analyzer’s tray.
Start the calibration of the sensor cartridge.
Add 100 μl of serum-free Schneider's Drosophila medium to all wells of the Cell-Tak-coated microplate kept at RT.
Dispense 100 μl of the cell suspension from step 16 in C to each sample well.
Add 100 μl of serum-free Schneider's Drosophila medium to the background/control wells.
Centrifuge the microplate at 200 g for 1 min without using a braking system.
Transfer the microplate to the 25°C incubator for 25-30 minutes to ensure cell attachment.
Confirm that most of the cells have adhered to the bottom of the wells using an inverted microscope.
Slowly and gently add 400 μl of serum-free Schneider's Drosophila medium along the side of each well to avoid disturbing the cells.
Further incubate the microplate in the 25°C incubator for 15 min.
Replace the utility plate from step 3 with the embryonic cell-seeded microplate and start the assay according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
After the assay, collect the cells using a 1-ml pipette.
Lysate the cell pellet using a 5-10x volume of RIPA buffer.
Measure the total protein concentration using a BCA assay kit.
